Subject: Encoding pipeline screen: run-of-show, proctoring, and shadow plan

Team —

We have Samir Patel's ML/coding screen booked for Wed 29 Sep 10:30–11:30 PT. This thread is to lock the run-of-show, interviewer roles, and the proctor/shadow plan so ops is clean and we get useful debrief signals. Key asks below — please confirm by EOD today.

Quick overview:
- Candidate: Samir Patel (applied via TalentLane) — resume in Drive.
- Focus: encoding pipeline problem (streamed data, batching, memory tradeoffs) — 45m live pair + 15m debrief.
- Platforms: Redwood CoderPad (linked below), Zoom for face + screen share, shared Colab for any quick infra experiments.

Asks: 
1) Kimberly — will you lead the first 35m pair-programming (prompt + incremental grading) and take primary time checks?
2) Karthik — can you run the 10m system design mini (latency/kv-cache tradeoffs) and carry the rubric scoring?
3) Neha — please proctor, record the session, note any environment flakiness, and capture tokens/latency hits in the attached run_of_show PDF. Also confirm you can observe without stepping in unless time is lost.

Run-of-show and rubric attached. Links: CoderPad (interactive pad), Drive folder (candidate artifacts), Zoom link + calendar invite (I sent the invite to Samir — recruiter CC'd).

If any of the roles above don't fit your calendar, call out a swap option and name a backup. Also flag any platform concerns (CoderPad runtime, Colab GPU availability).

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Hiring Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-09-27_run_of_show_encoding_screen.pdf, encoding-screen-rubric.xlsx

Thanks Mateo — I can take lead on the pair-programming. A couple of micro-requests:

- Prefer to use the CoderPad "python-exec" runner that supports stdin/stdout and has a 1.5s timeout per test. Is that the pad linked? (I'll validate runtime before the session.)
- For the first 15m, I'll present a short warmup prompt to check the candidate's environment familiarity (file layout, imports) — call this out in the run-of-show so Samir knows expectations.
- If an earlier candidate test takes longer than expected, can we compress the system-design segment to 5–7m? I'm happy to coordinate with Karthik during the session.

I confirmed the calendar — Samir's timezone is IST (candidate will join at 23:00 IST). Maya, please reconfirm candidate consent for recording and Samir that evening timing works.

-Kimberly

Samir's quick Qs: 
1) Will he need to install any dependencies ahead of time? (He prefers to run in CoderPad's container or Colab if that's allowed.)
